'''Team Watto''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] team helmed by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Watto had since come into possession of the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] once used by his old [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and had planned to use it to enter the [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] race season with. Watto lacked a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], however. While Watto did eventually find a pilot, and although the team was not well regarded initially, it eventually became fairly successful, scoring numerous victories.

The team received help from the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] pilot [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]] up until he was killed during a race by [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], a [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Assassin/Legends|hit-man]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Beedo also happened to be working for the rival team known as [[Team Sebulba]].
